description: This file defines a Java interface for managing customer attributes within the sales manager system. It declares methods for saving, updating, and retrieving customer attribute data based on various criteria.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeService
classes.description: Interface providing service methods for CustomerAttribute management, including save, update, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerAttribute or updates an existing one, throwing ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute by merchant store, customer ID, and attribute ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes based on a merchant store and a value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes associated with a specific option ID in a store.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes for a given customer within a store.
